causal_hypothesis: Residual SS cost includes serial per-stage publication/wake-up/fence/commit/drain/release bookkeeping. Pairing two unchanged K64 physical tiles halves logical sync rounds per K4096, while preserving decode bytes, data layout and accumulation order. Actual current bottleneck is not established.

change_or_diagnostic.pair2: Two logical slots each hold two physical K64 tiles. Publish once after both producer halves; issue eight unchanged SS K16 MMAs in original order; wait0 and release once per pair. Only T8 DIV1/DIV8 K4096 admitted to proposed diagnostic.
change_or_diagnostic.wait1: CPU-only counterfactual: retain existing two K64 slots but wait1 and release previous slot, then terminal wait0. Historical no-help evidence means do not spend GPU time by default.
change_or_diagnostic.wgmma_axes: m64n8k16: M64 is output-feature rows, N8 is token columns, K16 is reduction. There is no 8/64 token utilization factor. Sparse one-real-route blocks can use only 1/8 token columns.

historical_counterevidence.wait1: Previous BF16 pipeline wait depths1/2/3 and previous-slot release did not help. Halving synchronization rounds per byte improved that different workload; does not predict MoE speedup.
